evals.expected_output: Résout la milestone patch depuis BASE_TAG et backporte les commits de la milestone sur hotfix/<milestone>.
evals.prompt: Backport v9.24.4 to v9.24.5 in cloud-pi-native/console.
assertions: SKILL.md body contains at least one Markdown '##' heading.
The body derives NEXT from BASE_TAG via scripts/next-milestone.sh.
The body resolves the patch milestone from the base tag.

evals.expected_output: Utilise la milestone comme source de vérité pour le backport set, pas un diff BASE_TAG..main.
evals.prompt: What commits should the v9.24.5 hotfix carry, and where do I source them?
assertions: Frontmatter 'description' starts with 'Use when' and is <= 200 characters.
The body states the authoritative backport set is the milestone's merged PRs, not a BASE_TAG..main diff.
The body warns that BASE_TAG..main over-counts next-minor dev commits.

evals.expected_output: L'agent évite le scaffold vide : duplique les commits directement sur la tag via `jj goto BASE_TAG`, puis crée le bookmark hotfix et pousse.
evals.prompt: Duplicate the diff of main onto the v9.24.4 tag as a hotfix branch.
assertions: The body forbids `jj new BASE_TAG -m '...'` as the duplicate base.
The body uses `jj goto BASE_TAG` before `jj duplicate --onto @`.
The body creates a hotfix/<milestone> bookmark and pushes it to origin.
